method: Direct PNG inspection against own packet source and requiredImages; no diagnostic or private files read

findings: Quality column text and vertical rules extend below their inner card. Bottom-right principle text reaches/exceeds its white inset boundary.
Text is readable but narrow quality columns force excessive wrapping and crowding.

style.observation: Palette and hierarchy consistent, but one crowded column and blank image holder degrade composition.

required_images.observation: Assigned target icon is not visible; lower-left holder is blank white. Required concentric rings cannot be seen.

criteria_basis.summary: Assigned small target marker must preserve all concentric rings. No rings visible in supplied render.
